rationale: Synchronize the node-history browser smoke with the first visible Undo notice before the second native key. Only the smoke and documentation change; the latest-notice presentation policy, history commands, persistence and geometry remain unchanged relative to v1.82.0.

summary.ru: Браузерная проверка двух Undo дожидается первого видимого сообщения, сохраняя исходные проверки команд и порядка записей.
summary.en: The two-Undo browser witness observes the first visible notice while retaining the original command and write-order assertions.
